text: watched a growth guy set up fifty posting accounts then realize every single one needs a different person on camera. no swaps. no recasts. no hardlaunch. just him in the mirror doing fifty different voices for fifty different brands. we lost a good one today
base_video: Creator stands in a bedroom holding two phones, looking slowly left then right off camera like they are trying to find who said that, then back to lens.
caption: how many accounts are you running right now
why_this_brand: Fifty warmed posting accounts all needing a different face on camera is the exact wall this product is built at.
what_changed: Cut the cousin-booked-for-saturday line so the block stays on the single mirror image.

format.reason: HardLaunch is a SaaS whose pain is an ops nightmare, chasing creators on WhatsApp, casting calls, invoice spreadsheets, and that whole 'old way' lands harder as a silent deadpan reaction to a block of text than as a product demo. The audience of media buyers and agency operators will recognise themselves in the 11pm CPM-climbing scene instantly, which drives the shares and tagged-colleague comments that awareness posts need.
format.why_not_runner_up: It needs real recast before/after footage the brand has to supply, and leading with the face-swap mechanic invites the consent and deepfake comment fights the brand explicitly avoids.

editor_fix: pick one absurd image: either the mirror doing fifty voices or the cousin booked for saturday, not both, so the block stays one moment.
